rows.note: Use 知識 as the all-purpose noun for general knowledge, subject knowledge, and an accumulated body of information.

example.english: This book has given me a lot of knowledge.
example.traditional: 呢本書幫我增加咗好多知識。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 bong1 ngo5 zang1 gaa1 zo2 hou2 do1 zi1 sik1

rows.note: Use 理解 for intellectual grasp or appreciation of information, rather than for a body of facts.

example.english: After your explanation, I have a deeper knowledge of the whole matter.
example.traditional: 聽完你嘅解釋，我對成件事有咗更深嘅理解。
example.jyutping: teng1 jyun4 nei5 ge3 gaai2 sik1 ngo5 deoi3 sing4 gin6 si6 jau5 zo2 gang3 sam1 ge3 lei5 gaai2

rows.note: Use 認知 when the focus is awareness or recognition of a particular fact or situation.

example.english: Society's knowledge of cybersecurity is still insufficient.
example.traditional: 社會對網絡安全嘅認知仍然不足。
example.jyutping: se5 wui6 deoi3 mong5 lok6 on1 cyun4 ge3 jing6 zi1 jing4 jin4 bat1 zuk1

rows.note: Use 見識 for experience-based or firsthand awareness of something, rather than bare awareness of a fact.

example.english: After travelling to several countries, I really broadened my knowledge.
example.traditional: 去咗幾個國家旅行之後，我真係增廣咗見識。
example.jyutping: heoi3 zo2 gei2 go3 gwok3 gaa1 leoi5 hang4 zi1 hau6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 zang1 gwong2 zo2 gin3 sik1
